name: WF-434 — Seller Contact Attempt Outcome & Automated Follow-Up Sequencing Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const contactAttemptId=String(b.contactAttemptId??b.attemptId??'').trim(); const channel=String(b.channel??'unknown').trim().toLowerCase(); const outcome=String(b.outcome??'').trim().toLowerCase(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,contactAttemptId,channel,outcome,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Contact Attempt Outcome').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const blocked=['dnc','do_not_contact','suppressed','closed','cancelled']; const terminal=['not_interested','wrong_number','invalid_contact','dnc']; const positive=['interested','appointment_set','call_back_requested','offer_requested','qualified']; const neutral=['no_answer','voicemail','busy','message_sent','email_sent','sms_sent']; const o=input.outcome; const leadStatus=String(ctx.leadStatus??ctx.status??'').toLowerCase(); const flags=[]; if(blocked.includes(leadStatus)||o==='dnc')flags.push('contact_blocked'); const prior=Array.isArray(ctx.recentAttempts)?ctx.recentAttempts:[]; const sameAttempt=prior.some(x=>String(x.contactAttemptId??x.id??'')===input.contactAttemptId); if(sameAttempt)flags.push('duplicate_contact_attempt'); const suppression=ctx.suppressed===true||ctx.dnc===true; if(suppression)flags.push('suppressed_or_dnc'); let state='manual_review',nextAction='review_contact_outcome'; if(flags.length){state='blocked';nextAction='stop_all_follow_up';} else if(terminal.includes(o)){state=o==='dnc'?'dnc':'closed_lost';nextAction=o==='dnc'?'stop_all_follow_up':'mark_lead_closed_lost';} else if(positive.includes(o)){state=o==='appointment_set'?'appointment_follow_up':'sales_follow_up';nextAction=o==='appointment_set'?'confirm_appointment':'priority_human_follow_up';} else if(neutral.includes(o)){state='follow_up_sequence';nextAction='schedule_next_sequence_step';} const sequence=ctx.sequence??{}; const currentStep=Number(sequence.currentStep??input.sequenceStep??0); const maxSteps=Math.max(1,Number(sequence.maxSteps??7)); const cadenceMinutes=Array.isArray(sequence.cadenceMinutes)?sequence.cadenceMinutes:[60,240,1440,4320,10080]; const nextStep=currentStep+1; const delayMinutes=cadenceMinutes[Math.min(nextStep-1,cadenceMinutes.length-1)]??1440; const shouldSchedule=state==='follow_up_sequence'&&nextStep<=maxSteps; const scheduledFor=shouldSchedule?new Date(Date.now()+delayMinutes*60000).toISOString():null; const idempotencyKey='wf434:'+input.leadId+':'+input.contactAttemptId; return [{json:{...input,contactOutcomeDecision:{status:flags.length?'blocked':'evaluated',state,nextAction,contactClassification:positive.includes(o)?'positive':terminal.includes(o)?'negative':neutral.includes(o)?'neutral':'unknown',sequence:{currentStep,nextStep,maxSteps,delayMinutes,scheduledFor,shouldSchedule},flags,requiresHumanReview:state==='manual_review',confidenceScore:flags.length?15:(state==='manual_review'?55:92)},idempotencyKey}}];
